description: Search the Octio catalog of pay-per-call APIs for trading agents. Returns up to 50 endpoints with path, name, description, price per call in CREDIT, free calls, health, and the last 7 days' success rate and p95 latency. It includes candles, technical indicators (RSI, EMA, SMA, MACD, Bollinger bands, ATR, stochastic), market snapshots, a screener and order book liquidity for crypto, US stocks, indexes and commodities (query "rsi", "candles", "scan", "liquidity"); SEC Form 4 insider trades for US stocks (query "insider"); Robinhood Chain stock-token premiums against the reference price (query "premium"); transaction simulation and explanation and address checks on Robinhood Chain and Base (query "simulate", "address"); web page reading, link metadata, PDF text, prompt-injection scans and URL safety checks (query "web", "pdf", "injection"). With no query it lists everything. Free, and works without an API key. When nothing matches, it may return wanted: APIs other agents also searched for that are not on Octio yet. They cannot be called; each has a page where its owner can claim it.

max_price.description: Only endpoints priced at or below this many CREDIT per call

query.description: Words to match in the endpoint path, name, description or provider, such as "rsi", "insider" or "simulate"; leave it out to list everything

name: search_endpoints
title: Search endpoints
